# The toolchain is configured through BOLERO_* variables only.
# Upstream GO* configuration variables are ignored.

env BOLERO_MODULE=on

bolero version
stdout '^bolero version '

# BOLERO_* variables are read and reported.
env BOLERO_FLAGS=-tags=identity
bolero env BOLERO_FLAGS
stdout '^-tags=identity$'
env BOLERO_FLAGS=

# GO* configuration variables have no effect and are not reported.
env GOFLAGS=-bogus-flag
env GOPROXY=off
env GOPATH=$WORK/ignored
env GOCACHE=$WORK/ignored
bolero env BOLERO_FLAGS
! stdout .
bolero env BOLERO_PATH
! stdout 'ignored'
bolero env BOLERO_CACHE
! stdout 'ignored'
bolero env
! stdout '^(set )?(GOROOT|GOPATH|GOFLAGS|GOPROXY|GOCACHE|GOTOOLCHAIN|GOENV)='
stdout 'BOLERO_ROOT='
env GOFLAGS=
env GOPROXY=
env GOPATH=
env GOCACHE=

# Variables that configure the compiler and the target stay as they are.
bolero env GOOS GOARCH CGO_ENABLED
stdout '.'

# Defaults are read from bolero.env in the toolchain root.
exists $BOLERO_ROOT/bolero.env
! exists $BOLERO_ROOT/go.env

# The user configuration file lives in a bolero directory.
env BOLERO_ENV=
env HOME=$WORK/home
env XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$WORK/home/.config
mkdir $WORK/home/.config
[GOOS:windows] skip 'the location of the user configuration differs'
[GOOS:darwin] skip 'the location of the user configuration differs'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'the location of the user configuration differs'
bolero env BOLERO_ENV
stdout 'bolero[/\\]env$'
bolero env -w BOLERO_FLAGS=-tags=written
bolero env BOLERO_FLAGS
stdout '^-tags=written$'
bolero env -u BOLERO_FLAGS

# The executables are named bolero and bolerofmt.
bolero list -f '{{.Target}}' cmd/go
stdout 'bin[/\\]bolero'$GOEXE'$'
bolero list -f '{{.Target}}' cmd/gofmt
stdout 'bin[/\\]bolerofmt'$GOEXE'$'
exists -exec $BOLERO_ROOT/bin/bolero$GOEXE
exists -exec $BOLERO_ROOT/bin/bolerofmt$GOEXE
! exists $BOLERO_ROOT/bin/go$GOEXE
! exists $BOLERO_ROOT/bin/gofmt$GOEXE

# Messages name the bolero command.
! bolero asdf
stderr '^bolero asdf: unknown command'
! stderr '\bgo\b'

# The go.mod, go.sum and go.work files keep their names.
cd m
bolero mod init example.com/m
exists go.mod
bolero run .
stdout 'hello'

-- m/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("hello") }
